A LITTLE KNOW-HOW

Keep it
looking good.

A good cut should be easy to live with. Choose a style for a short, practical care note you can return to between visits.

YOUR GUIDE / 01

Give the shape room.

Towel dry, then use a pea-sized amount of matte product. Work from the back forward so the front keeps its natural movement.

A trim every 4–6 weeks keeps the outline crisp.
